note: Annual election of one member for each of the five wards of the urban district, polled on Monday 15 January 1934. After withdrawals only Curran Ward was contested; the other four wards returned their members unopposed. Unopposed; new member (the outgoing member S. M'Meekin withdrew). Returned unopposed.
